source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
and release exactly one each time I press a lever, so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

requirements.statement_verbatim: a wall-mounted dispenser for small items
requirements.observable_verbatim: a product fixed to a wall that gives out the items it holds

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should hold about twenty of them
requirements.observable_verbatim: the number of items held at once

requirements.statement_verbatim: release exactly one each time I press a lever
requirements.observable_verbatim: the number of items released per press

requirements.statement_verbatim: so I never get two at once
requirements.observable_verbatim: the number of items released per press, at its maximum

requirements.statement_verbatim: I refill it from the top
requirements.observable_verbatim: a path by which items are put in, entering from above

requirements.statement_verbatim: without taking it off the wall
requirements.observable_verbatim: refilling performed with the product still fixed in place

requirements.statement_verbatim: It must not jam when it is nearly empty
requirements.observable_verbatim: release continues to occur when few items remain

actors.name: user

the opening through which items are put in

scenarios.name: releasing one item

scenarios.system_boundary: the product, the items being added and the wall
scenarios.environment: product remains fixed to the wall throughout

scenarios.name: fixing to the wall
scenarios.system_boundary: the product, the wall and whoever fixes it

freedoms.decision: how one item is separated from the rest
freedoms.why_free: the text requires one at a time and names no means of achieving it

freedoms.decision: how the items are held before release
how the product is fixed to the wall
freedoms.why_free: wall-mounted is stated; no fixing, wall type or orientation is
the text gives two counts and no length, area or mass

freedoms.decision: whether the pressed surface returns on its own
freedoms.why_free: the text says press and does not say what happens after

ambiguities.statement: What are the small items - their size, shape, weight and whether they are all alike?
Does about twenty bound the capacity or describe it?
ambiguities.resolvable_when: a tolerance on the count is stated
a remaining count or fill level is stated

ambiguities.statement: What counts as jamming, and is a release that produces nothing the same failure as one that produces two?
What wall is it mounted to, and what fixings are acceptable?
ambiguities.resolvable_when: the wall construction and permitted fixings are stated

ambiguities.statement: Is refilling ordinary use or a maintenance activity?
ambiguities.resolvable_when: the frequency or role of refilling is stated
